classificationPolicy.superseded: stable patch-id matches a commit reachable from the local upstream ref universe
classificationPolicy.recovered: commit is reachable from the candidate branch and has no upstream patch-id equivalent
classificationPolicy.deadLetter: commit is preserved by another local ref but is not part of the candidate recovery line
classificationPolicy.merge: merge commits carry an explicit merge marker instead of a synthetic patch-id
